_comment: Per-competition Dixon-Coles rho, fitted by maximum likelihood on a chronological training split. Competitions absent from this table use the default. Regenerate with scripts/fit_rho.py.
_wave1_note: Wave 1 values fitted by scripts/validate_wave1.py on the first half of each competition's history and validated on the second. The 43 active capabilities were measured at these values; changing one invalidates that competition's capabilities until revalidated.
